name: comp-128

frames.best_why: The card reads as a whole with heading, subtitle and right chevron, and no cursor covers text.

tagline: A wide outlined tile with a title, a hint and an arrow pointing onward.
summary: A single outlined button shaped like a card: a bold heading over a smaller grey subtitle, with a small right chevron at the edge. Hovering nudges the chevron right.
appearance: A wide dark rounded rectangle with a thin outline sits on a near-black stage, carrying a bold "Talent Agency" heading above a grey line "Matches for your roster" and a small right-pointing chevron near its right edge.
behaviour: Hovering the tile slides the chevron a fraction to the right and lightens the border; the heading and hint stay put. The whole surface is one button meant to navigate onward.
demo_content: The heading "Talent Agency" and subtitle "Matches for your roster".
search_phrases: navigation row with title and description
menu item card that links away
subtitle under heading inside a button
use_when: A menu or settings list needs a large single-choice card with a title, a hint and an onward arrow.
avoid_when: The heading and hint are fixed text and no link is wired, so it cannot actually open anything.
customise: There are no props: the heading, subtitle and lone chevron are literals, so using it with your own words means copying and editing.
weight_why: One outlined button with two lines of text and a small hover nudge.

a11y.note: The visible text names the button and focus is ringed, but no handler is attached so activation leads nowhere.

issues: No link or click handler is attached, so the card cannot navigate anywhere.
polish_why: Clear heading and hint with a tidy chevron; the hover nudge is almost invisible.
title: Navigation Card Button
